text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A correspondent for the German Press Agency DPA was asked to leave the country because of a report she wrote.
- Crown prince thanks United Arab Emirates' president for the 100 million dirhams he granted Bahrain to build houses.
- Elections to the board of the Bahrain Chamber of Commerce and Industry are set for October 22.
- First Islamic Investment Bank (FIIB) board appoints Saudi Mohammad Abdulaziz Al Jomaih as chairman.
- A German minister praises economic policy by Bahrain's prime minister.
- Residential projects worth 16 million dinars underway.
- Real estate worth 45.58 million dinars changed hands in the first half of 1997.
